<when condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode < 400)">
            
            <set-variable name="healthStatus" value="@{
                var body = context.Response.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
                return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace((string)body["status"]) ? (string)body["status"] : "Healthy";
            }" />

                        }' />
                        <metadata name="ResponseStatusCode" value='@{
